name: rasa.module.role.engineering-lead
description: The Engineering Lead role (`engineering-lead`) as a RasaOS role module. The ask is software: a feature, a fix, an audit of code, infrastructure or a decision about them

rasa.note: PROVISIONAL (galt ADR 0064; tenant ADR 2026-10-10-roles-are-element-modules D2): canon has no kind: role yet, so a role is a module. role.json and prompt.md are what galt reads to publish the role and to load it as an agent's brain; .claude-plugin/plugin.json makes the repo loadable with --plugin-dir. The repo is role-engineering-lead (the ADR 0064 form, and canon's once kind: role lands), not module-role-engineering-lead. No permissions: the role's gate grants are in role.json and reach a session only through a role assignment a person publishes.
